ingestion.YouTube: Poll each channel's RSS (https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=ID) weekly; no login or API key; returns the last 15 uploads. Drop #shorts and filter titles for Review/Series/Hindi Dubbed. NOTE 2026-11-04 17:30 PT: the RSS endpoint returned HTTP 404 for every channel (also for channels whose feed worked earlier today), so the weekly build falls back to yt_channel.py, which reads https://www.youtube.com/@HANDLE/videos.
ingestion.X: Built-in public X reads: get_users_posts(id, start_time=7 days ago, exclude=retweets,replies). The IDs are saved in the JSON; at ~20 posts per account per week this fits easily within rate limits (1000 reads/day).
ingestion.Instagram: Not reliably machine-readable without a login. Treat as a manual/optional source, or skip. Ormax charts are also on its website. Instagram-only sources (karan-mirchandani, india-movie-dekho) stay in the bandit but only get votes when a title is added by hand.
ingestion.Facebook: Same: login-walled for feeds; page title and follower count load, posts don't. Use the equivalent X/website/YouTube feeds.
ingestion.Websites: RSS for Indian Express, The Hindu, Rediff (filter /review/); HTML scrape for fcgreviews.com homepage and THR India /reviews.
ingestion.Showtimes: Fetch bigscreen.com Marquee pages (theater=29354 Fremont, 5994 Union City) weekly (Thu/Fri) and grep for Hindi/Telugu/Tamil Language tags; book through Cinemark/Fandango.
